en: I'm surprised you can talk.
Yes, can talk. Been Mudlark not long... Mist in me, still young.
But you know, other Mudlarks, they too talk. Vulture not listen.
Vulture... What name?
... It's Rodion.
Rodion... Thanks tell. I'm Ilya. Happy meet.
They call me Returner.
That is not name, is it? Can see in eye. That is title... You not proud...
I won't say "Returner". You don't want.
What are you doing here?
I am Mudlark. Here live. Carry dead, make dance.
Mudlarks... The corpse-bearers?
Yes. Throw corpse in Lake. Make no Mist.
Tell me about the Mudlarks.
About family... Nice see interest. Not many ask Ilya...
What are these corpses around here?
Vulture seeks corpses... Is nature. Bandits, fresh... From highway.
They wait here. Lying still... Wait for Mist...
Another Vulture here... "Zhivan". You should talk...
About these dead bodies around...
Yes, we carry here. But, why you seek?
I have to leave, now. Take care.
Anything valuable on them?
Sorry. Don’t know. I just pull. Pull corpse here...
Other Vulture... He there, rum, r-rummaging. He get thing from corpses. Maybe value?
Who's this other Vulture?
Name Zhivan. Look nice. Vultures nice to Ilya... You nice too...
Go talk? Maybe good?
Don't you ever take their armor or weapons for yourselves?
Most of us no use.
Sometimes take shiny thing, I did one time... No one asked...
What did you take?
I don’t...  I don’t remember.
About something else.
Let's talk about something else, now.
Why do you carry corpses to the Lake?
Corpse draws Mist. People no want Mist.
But Mist not understood; is life; life consume death – it's all cycle. Only Mudlark know this.
So we throw in Lake Pavlie. Great water, Mist suffocate. We do this for make living, but...
You don't agree with throwing corpses into the Lake?
No. Corpse is for celebrating, dancing, singing. Death make way for life. It's cycle.
How do you get by?
You mean... How live? They give food, pay... For carry corpse.
Acolytes because of Cemetery. Palatines because safety. Even Mechanists...
Nobody want bodies... All willing pay...
What kinds of rituals do Mudlarks perform?
We stack corpses...  Make totems. Icons. Burn parts, dance others, sometimes sing. Very hard...
We use The Food... Berries and mushrooms we know. The Food open mind... Lets see all.
So you worship the bodies?
No. No, dead body normal. Nothing to sing to.
But the Mist, when it comes – that is the world. World made of Mist. We sing to that.
The Food... So you take drugs?
"Drugs"... Improve... Yes. We see more, with The Food... Eyes open, Mist come in.
Whole world is one thing. Balls of lightning and death... Fields of Mist and living.
All connected. Things as truly are. Cycle.
Those rituals...  Don’t they go against what the Church says?
Go against... We no believe Church. Us... Not friends.
I wish friends...
They see those rituals as defiling the dead.
We don't want... defile. Try respect. We even go to Cemetery, bury things like they do. Sometime.
But we need corpses always. Need throw in Lake, get paid; need make totem, dance and sing. Talk to Mist.
Let me ask about something else.
(I've told Ilya about the corpses.)
Oh... Tell?
I have to tell you about some corpses.
Corpses, corpses... Death. Where death?
Never mind.
Good. I... I rush. Fast. H-Haste.
Oh, I see. Dangerous there... I ask elders to go... Monsters no attack. But no much hurry in scrap place, Mist there a fact of life.
That's all the corpses I know of for now.
Thanks for telling... I try and organize. Have nothing to give for help...
Hmmm... Ah, know one thing! That Vulture there, with bodies. He muttering. Crazy about something.
Maybe he need help? Maybe you get big job if ask... So? Go talk.
That Vulture, huh – I'll go ask him, then.
Good. Glad to help...
Of course. Take care, friend.
You too...
Sure, whatever you say.
Ilich, at Zalesski Cemetery.
A Palatine boy, already drawing in Mist.
Bandits in the Scrapyard.
Left quite a few.
Vulture... I see you before... I'm Ilya, Mudlark... What need?
Ah, Vulture...  Good to see...
How are you...
Hello...
Hello, corpse-bearer.
Can we talk, Ilya?
Hello, Ilya. Wanna chat.
You have anything to trade?
Let's trade, corpse-bearer.
We could do some trading.
I have a message from Alexei.
There's something you should know about.
Got some work for you, Ilya.
I've told you every corpse I've found.
You've got your work cut out for you.
Good luck with all that work.
Give something good, I try give good back.
Yes, trade, like Vultures do...
Ilya can trade... Mudlarks trade...
Alright, bye...
Okay, come back if need.
See later.
Until another time...
To and fro, go and come back, the cycle...
...You can be friend of Mudlarks if want... Vulture...
...You friend of Mudlarks, yes? We see again, Rodion?
I'll clear your path.
Much thanks... Be safe...
Need to think, first.
Ok... It's ok... Take time.
What else do you need?
Glad to help anytime.
Let me know if something comes up.
I'll find what you want.
Yes, thank you... Please find.
I need some time to think.
Oh, ok...
Do you have other requests?
Don't worry about it.
Ok... Have fun.
You need help with something?
Anything I can help the Mudlarks with?
Need the services of a Vulture?
So much death, but cannot reach... Marked map. Corpses... Monsters... Help, Vulture. We meet after, have reward.
Need do job... Reach corpse. But monsters there... Give hurt... Will you help? Ilya give thing if you do...
You do good! Ilya happy... Take this.
Ilya job more easy, now. You good! Here you go...
Thanks... This helps much. You good for Ilya.
Need more than have. Every day, don’t know why. Want touch, look, smell. If Vulture go danger place, take what Ilya want... Things for things...
Things that need... Because look good, or smell good, or touch good. Other Mudlarks don’t let have... Ilya get secret... You help?
Found thing! Good thing, Ilya likes...
Thank you... Ilya likes this. This is good...
Thank you, this is wanted. It looks, feels good... Thanks...
Sorry, Ilya just a Mudlark. Not much else to ask...
You have ask, but I don't know... Got nothing...

Rodion... Friend... Where you?

I'm getting away from here anyway.

Of course not. It was Angel... Leader of those Western soldiers.
Sure. Thanks for the help, Ilya.
